diagnosis: update_subscription_group allows updating the broadcast group associated with a browser push notification registration. The lookup PushInformation.objects.filter(id=subscription_id) does not check user ownership. An attacker can alter the notification group of other users' devices to silence high-priority alerts or subscribe them to unauthorized broadcast notification streams.
